users.description: Requires entity users right r. Returns a raw array ordered by primary key. More than 10,000 candidate rows returns 503. Ordinary callers are restricted to their organization; userlog records are scoped through their owning user. Asset matching is delegated to the Assets reader. Deleted records may remain visible to authorized readers.  The shared handler also accepts the implicit entity_id query parameter; GET then returns one record and skips collection filters. Authentication and rights are checked against current Users database state. Deleted users and expired sessions are rejected. For every noninternal caller, m_sHash, m_sCode, m_sToken and m_sOldLogin are projected as empty strings in successful responses; wire member names are preserved.

assets.description: Requires entity permission read. Supplying entity_id selects one record and changes the response from an array to an object. Ordinary callers are scoped by their organization AND (user OR groups); privileged callers may use the documented filters. The default API runtime supplements Redis method rights with bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context checks of current SQL identity, organization, signed role level, memberships and requested method rights. Stale cached actor state fails closed; the separately configured trusted internal credential keeps its explicit service authority. Ordinary asset access requires the caller organization AND an explicit user OR current group assignment. Item GET and item-selected collection GET enforce the same SQL scope; denied PUT and DELETE cannot change state or append mutation audit.
